bar.name: Single Malts
bar.description: Explore distinctive single malt whiskies, from gentle fruit and honey to rich oak and smoky peat. Each bottle reflects the character of its distillery.

bar.name: World Whisky
bar.description: Discover whisky styles from around the world, including Irish, American, Japanese and other international expressions. Explore flavours ranging from soft and fruity to bold and spicy.

bar.name: Made in India Whisky
bar.description: Discover Indian whiskies shaped by local ingredients, diverse regions and warm-climate maturation. Explore approachable blends and characterful malt expressions.

bar.name: Blended Scotch
bar.description: A collection of blended Scotch whiskies combining malt and grain spirits. Discover balanced profiles with notes of vanilla, dried fruit, spice and gentle smoke.

bar.name: Gin
bar.description: Explore classic and contemporary gins with juniper-led botanical character. Discover citrus, floral, herbal and spice notes for your preferred pour or cocktail.

bar.name: Rum
bar.description: Discover white, dark, aged and spiced rums with flavours ranging from fresh and light to rich caramel, vanilla and warming spice.

bar.name: Vodka
bar.description: Explore classic and flavoured vodkas with clean, subtle profiles. Choose a bottle for a chilled pour, a refreshing mixer or a favourite cocktail.

bar.name: Brandy
bar.description: Discover brandies with fruit-led character and flavours of dried fruit, oak, vanilla and spice. Explore different origins, styles and maturation levels.

bar.name: Tequila
bar.description: Explore agave spirits across blanco, reposado and añejo tequila styles. Discover fresh herbal character, gentle spice and the richer notes of oak maturation.

bar.name: Liqueurs
bar.description: Discover liqueurs featuring fruit, herbs, coffee, cream and other distinctive flavours. Explore bottles for cocktails, dessert pairings or an after-dinner pour.

bar.name: Sake
bar.description: Explore Japanese rice-based sake in a range of styles. Discover delicate floral aromas, fruit notes and savoury character; serving temperature depends on the bottle.

bar.name: Ready to Drink
bar.description: Convenient ready-to-drink options, including bottled and canned mixed drinks. Explore refreshing flavours and familiar cocktail-inspired combinations.

bar.name: Beers
bar.description: Discover beers across a variety of styles, from crisp lagers and refreshing wheat beers to hop-led ales and richer dark brews.

bar.name: Champagne
bar.description: Explore Champagne from France’s Champagne region. Discover lively bubbles, citrus and orchard fruit, with richer toasted notes in some expressions.

bar.name: Sparkling Wine
bar.description: Discover sparkling wines from different regions and grape varieties. Explore fresh, fruit-led styles and elegant bubbles for your preferred occasion.

bar.name: Rosé Wine
bar.description: Explore rosé wines with flavours ranging from delicate red berries to fuller, fruit-forward profiles. Discover different regions, grape varieties and sweetness levels.

bar.name: Red Wine
bar.description: Discover red wines from light and fruit-led to rich and structured. Explore grape varieties and regions with flavours of berries, spice, oak and more.

bar.name: White Wine
bar.description: Explore white wines from crisp and citrus-led to aromatic or fuller-bodied styles. Discover different grape varieties, regions and flavour profiles.
